body: Burst texts wait in the persisted slot buffer (Slot.buffer, at-least-once as TASK-017) and only the per-slot deadline lives in memory (Slots.gathers: first/due, woken via next_deadline); flush holds front texts while the gather is not due and then sends the leading text run as one Inbound. Alternative rejected: a separate in-memory batch outside the buffer (lost on hub crash, a second ordering source next to files).

Burst meta: message_id = the LAST part (usually the user's own note; its channel record is the one the transcript shows, so it is the receipt key), message_ids = all parts comma-separated in order (only when >1), reply_to_message_id/target_agent from the last part that explicitly replies, forwarded only when every part is a forward. All parts turn ✍ through registry Stream.parts (key -> other ids, serde default, pruned with receipts). Alternative rejected: parsing message_ids from the channel tag in crates/transcript (StreamItem::Channel is produced by the agent-side tail and crosses the wire; old agents would never send it).

Options::gather_quiet/gather_max default to ZERO (gathering off) and hub/mod.rs sets GATHER_QUIET 1 s / GATHER_MAX 3 s, like status_every (None by default, STATUS_EVERY in the hub). Alternative rejected: on by default, which would delay every existing unit and e2e test that expects an immediate inbound per message.

A gather is created only for a text parked while the slot has a live agent and is dropped when flush finds no live agent; messages kept for a dead/offline slot go one by one on revival as before (TASK-017 unchanged). Alternative rejected: coalescing the revival backlog too (task says dead-slot buffering unchanged).

Review items 1+2: a burst is cut where (thread_id, reply_to) changes, so one inbound has one addressee (session or one subagent) and one reply target; burst_meta then takes inbound_meta of the last part. Alternative rejected: keeping mixed parts and rendering each reply target inline in content (target_agent still needs a split, and a reply to a wordless message has no quote to render).

Review item 3: Gather remembers the message id of its first part (start); a front text kept before start (start still waits behind it) goes alone at once. Alternative rejected: the review's 'create a gather only when the buffer is empty', which would stop a text behind a file being fetched from starting its own burst (breaks a_file_in_a_burst_lets_the_burst_go_first_and_keeps_its_place).

Review items 4+5: whether a channel message fires UserPromptSubmit is unverified, so the actor cannot see the turn a batch starts; a console command is refused with BUSY_NOTICE while the slot still keeps messages (link queue full, file on its way) or topic texts went to the session less than Options::inbound_settle ago (hub: INBOUND_SETTLE 3 s, default ZERO like gather). Alternative rejected: queueing the command behind the texts (the typed command would still land in the turn they start).
